tools.name: stye_fit_to_duration
tools.description:
Find tracks that FIT A SPECIFIC RUNTIME — for a cut of known length.

    Considers both tracks whose natural runtime is close to the target (fit='native') and
    dedicated timed cutdowns such as a 30-second mix (fit='cutdown'). For cutdowns,

tools.name: stye_get_track
tools.description:
Full detail for one track: metadata, editorial description, every available
    version (stems, cutdowns, alternate mixes), and a streamable watermarked preview
    link (expires in 15 minutes). The preview is an evaluation copy — licensing is
    arranged with the Songs To Your Eyes team.

tools.name: stye_list_versions
tools.description:
Every version of a cue: the main mix, timed cutdowns (15s/30s/60s...), alternate
    mixes (no-drums, underscore, instrumental...) and individual instrument stems.
